quotes.text: The recorded Thunderbird accessibility-review guidance treats Bolt semantic `--color-*` tokens as expected theme tokens. For high contrast mode (HCM) review, inspect how each component uses those tokens for states, borders, and shadows, and check its `prefers-contrast` and `forced-colors` behavior. Token use alone was not a reported defect. This is intended review guidance; check the current tokens and component before applying it.
